items.anchor: Nor does the report claim convergence for every finite convex nonsmooth objective, a positive-measure basin for the deterministic seed, robustness to floating-point perturbation, or a rounded initial point lying exactly on the stable manifold.

discrepancies.description: Unresolved source-module letter. companion/chapters/14_E.tex:18 (Section 14.1 "What the checks mean", second paragraph; frozen span E.span.2, source bfgs_lean_stage1/master_report/latex/chapters/verification.tex:7) prints, on printed page 89 of the built companion (companion/build/master.pdf, PDF page 95): "The stable-manifold conclusion in L follows from the actual return map and a proved analytic argument, not a numerical starting vector assumed to lie on that manifold." "L" is the source report's letter for Chapter 13 ("Failure with positive lower curvature"); the printed companion numbers its chapters 1 to 14 and its appendices A and B, so the label "L" resolves to nothing (the suite labels "L-hyperbolicity", "L-embedding" of Section 14.3 appear only later and are explained only as labels of the original report). It is the "note C" / "A's gap" pattern of the letter-reference policy (C/09_C/prose/117), not a letter used as the name of an object ("the D run"). editorial/generate_companion.py rewrites module letters only in prefixed tags, in "Module L" phrases and in citation keys, not in a bare "in L". The mathematics of the sentence is true and proved: BfgsCoverage.Article.LowerCurvature.stable_manifold_positive_scale (the stable manifold of the hyperbolic fixed point P_* of the actual three-step return map enters τ > 0; A/lower_curvature/prose/036), whose orbits give the actual runs of Theorem 13.1 (BfgsCoverage.Companion.Ch13L.global_failure; the article's Proposition art:quadratic_failure, BfgsCoverage.Article.LowerCurvature.quadratic_failure). Fix: the chapter is generated, so not by hand. Add to editorial/generate_companion.py, in its block for module E (if module=='E':), a logged transformation (a transform_log entry with kind, old, new and reason) replacing the exact source text "The stable-manifold conclusion in L follows" (verification.tex:7, exactly one occurrence; assert the count) by "The stable-manifold conclusion in Chapter~\ref{comp:L} follows"; then regenerate (python3 editorial/generate_companion.py), rebuild the companion and inspect printed page 89.
discrepancies.proposed: "The stable-manifold conclusion in Chapter~\ref{comp:L} follows from the actual return map and a proved analytic argument, not a numerical starting vector assumed to lie on that manifold." (It prints "... in Chapter 13 follows ...".)
